nom: Hero Cosmetics Mighty Patch for Fine Lines Patches

concerns.aging: Reviewers use these on forehead lines, the 11's, and smile lines, reporting visibly reduced or less noticeable lines within hours to a couple of days of wearing them; one reviewer instead experienced burning and redness rather than any improvement.

aspects.libelle: Skin burning and redness on application
Cutting patches in half to extend value

extraits.texte: I applied these to my face where i seen fine lines and gently rubbed and it started burning and now have red burns on my face. I wouldn't try this again.
Other brands I've tried do not do a portion of what this brand does for me. I literally can tell a difference after a few hours of wearing this on my 11's.
I have the beginnings of a line in the mjddle of my forehead, and I feel like this really makes a difference!
Other nrands ive tried didnt do anything, i can see my lines go away after wearing this. Its expensive but at least it works. I cut them in half now to last longer.
These have drastically helped my smile lines pump up and become so much less noticeable. I will use them now before an event like a couple days before to snatch my face.

reserve: Only 5 of 7 reviews are usable and none mention the reviewer's skin type, so segmentation by skin type is not possible from this set.
